verdict.rationale: llama.cpp ships its own interfaces where users can feed in their data and get AI output: a built-in web UI on `llama serve` and CLI/VLM chat sessions (gh-3, gh-4). A hands-on user reports using its vision support to generate keywords, descriptions, OCR and location clues from their own trip photos (comm-14, comm-13). However, it is a general-purpose inference engine with no dedicated insights or suggestions feature tied to a user's data; data must be manually supplied through prompts or images. Missing for 10: purpose-built data-insight/suggestion features, connection to user data sources beyond manual prompt/image input, first-party documentation of insight workflows.
